overview: A Portuguese-language business website for TXMOVÉL Angola, a construction-materials supplier in Luanda, with a product catalogue, quote requests, and an owner dashboard.
features: Homepage with the new brand headline and product highlights
Quem Somos section describing the company
Catalogue of the five real construction products
Owner dashboard and menu panel that can be hidden or shown
Settings page to set and change the owner password
Owner can create email and password accounts for other users
